title: Find all non-carcinogenic molecules that contain at least one triple bond a
question: Find all non-carcinogenic molecules that contain at least one triple bond and also include a carbon atom involved in a double bond.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m."XCL_010"
FROM molecule AS m
INNER JOIN bond AS b_triple ON m."XCL_010" = b_triple."XCL_005"
WHERE m."XCL_011" = '-'
  AND b_triple."XCL_006" = '#'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom AS a
    INNER JOIN bond AS b_double ON a."XCL_002" = b_double."XCL_005"
    WHERE a."XCL_002" = m."XCL_010"
      AND a."XCL_003" = 'c'
      AND b_double."XCL_006" = '='
  )
